label: prop:joint-galois-braid-discharged
title: Joint motivic-Galois $\times$ braid action commutes on every bi-filtration cell — discharged
html:
The joint-action conjecture (Joint motivic-Galois \times braid-group action on the bi-filtration \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}) predicted commutativity of the motivic-Galois action G_{\mathrm{mot}} and the braid-group action B_{n_K} on every \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)} stratum. The conjecture is proved in general. The argument is structural: the two actions touch disjoint factors of the bi-filtration's underlying tensor structure.

For every (n, K), the actions G_{\mathrm{mot}} and B_{n_K} commute on \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}:

  g_{\mathrm{mot}}(\beta \cdot \alpha) \;=\; \beta \cdot g_{\mathrm{mot}}(\alpha)
  \quad\text{for } \alpha \in \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)},\;
  g_{\mathrm{mot}} \in G_{\mathrm{mot}},\;
  \beta \in B_{n_K}.
heading: Proposition
